infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kleos uses the camera while you record a take (Aura Farm, Debate Duels) so Poise can read your eye contact and posture. Videos are deleted after they are read.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kleos uses the microphone for live conversations and recorded takes, so the other person can reply and Poise can measure your pace, fillers and tone.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kleos opens your photo library only when you choose a clip to rate or screenshots of your profile to read.
